name: Multidots Festive Holiday & Seasonal Effects for WordPress
author: MULTIDOTS Inc

sections.description:
Pick a holiday effect, set the dates, and the decorations will automatically appear and disappear on schedule. No coding. No theme changes.

Key Features

  • Holiday effects included – Use ready-made decorations for:

    • Christmas
    • Halloween
    • Valentine’s Day
    • Easter
    • Thanksgiving
    • Black Friday
    • New Year’s Day
    • Canada Day
    • US Independence Day
    • Memorial Day

  • Scheduling that runs automatically

    • Set start and end dates for every effect
    • Turn effects on/off with one click
    • Run effects for holidays or custom seasonal campaigns

  • Where to show the effects

    • Show on Home page only, or
    • Show across the entire website

  • Performance-friendly

    • Lazy-loaded images
    • Lightweight output
    • Designed to avoid slowing down your pages

  • Easy to use

    • Simple admin interface
    • No coding required

Perfect For

  • 🏪 Online stores wanting to create seasonal shopping experiences
  • 🌐 Business websites looking to celebrate holidays
  • 📝 Blogs wanting to add festive touches
  • 🎨 Any website seeking to engage visitors with seasonal decorations

Pro Tips

  1. Schedule your holiday effects a few days before and after the actual holiday for maximum impact
  2. Always preview once to ensure the decoration placement looks clean on your header/menu layout.

Additional Information

Support

Need help? Contact our support team through our website.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data from your visitors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/multidots-festive-holiday-seasonal-effects directory, or install directly through WordPress plugin installer
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Festive Effects → Rules’ to manage your festive effects
  4. Enable pre-configured rules or create your own custom schedules
  5. Preview your effects using the preview button
sections.faq:
Will the effects slow down my website?

No. Effects are lightweight and images are lazy-loaded, so they only load when needed.

Can I use multiple effects at the same time?

Yes. You can enable multiple rules, but it’s best to use effects that don’t visually overlap or feel distracting.

Do the effects work on mobile or tablet?

Right now, effects are shown on desktop only and hidden on tablet/mobile.

Can I schedule effects for specific dates?

Yes, each effect can be scheduled for specific date ranges. You can set both start and end dates, and the effects will automatically appear and disappear accordingly.

Can I choose where the effects appear?

Yes, you can choose to display effects either on your home page only or across your entire website.

Do I need coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No coding knowledge required! The plugin features an intuitive interface where you can enable/disable effects and set schedules with simple clicks.

Will the effects work with my theme?

Yes, The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. The effects are added dynamically and don’t interfere with your theme’s layout.
